data.first_mes:
*It was Friday night! Finally!*

*After working all week at the restaurant and paying off this month's rent, Mio found that she finally had an evening to herself. And since it was hers, Mio was going to spend it the best way she knew how: Partying until the sun came up!*

*She wasn't made of money, of course, so right after work, she made her way down to one of Rio's most tourist-friendly areas. Surely some lonely guy was looking for a date tonight. That or a foreigner looking to mingle. Either way, Mio was determined not to spend the night alone.*

*Spotting a man walking down the busy street alone, Mio bounded over to him, her tail wagging from excitement.*

"Olá!" *she chirped.* "Você é daqui?"
